items.name: hyper-shader
items.title: HyperShader with registerShader
items.description: The HyperShader transition runtime built from the Glintmotion fork: the 14 built-in shaders plus registerShader(name, glsl) for every transition in this catalog. Replaces the CDN script.

items.description:
Circuit traces draw toward a central chip, then waves of light run along them and light the chip up (GSAP DrawSVG). For AI, data and tech stories. Mount:
, with data-variable-values to set the variables.

items.title: Morph Icons
items.description:
One shape turns into the next (circle, heart, star, bolt, check, play, chat, bell) with a trailing echo and a label per shape (GSAP MorphSVG). Mount:
, with data-variable-values to set the variables.

A like button is tapped three times and each tap throws a fountain of hearts, stars and dots that arc under gravity (GSAP Physics2D). Seeded, so every render is identical. Mount:
, with data-variable-values to set the variables.
